rows.year: 1930 (IA metadata; title page reads London: Faber & Faber, 24 Russell Square, no year printed)

rows.note: Eliot revised the translation in 1938 and 1949/1959; those revisions are NOT PD. The year here comes from IA metadata plus internal evidence, not a printed date -- Adam may want to eyeball the scan's verso. OCR of the first pages is noisy (cover scan).
